summary: Midway and John Woo's Hard Boiled sequel, starring Chow Yun-fat as Inspector Tequila.

entries.title: Stranglehold

emulation.notes: Use Windows where legally owned; emulate consoles only for collector-version comparison.

primary.why: Stranglehold released for Xbox 360 and Windows in September 2007, with PlayStation 3 following a month later. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the game itself.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively where legally owned; use PS3 Collector's Edition only if you specifically want the bundled Hard Boiled film on disc.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; console Collector's Editions include non-game extras.
